payload.title: Why your scheduled job fails silently on macOS
payload.question: why does my launchd job hang with no error and no output
payload.symptom: A background job that should text or push finishes with no error, sends nothing, and its own health check still reports green.
payload.cause: Under launchd, osascript driving Messages blocks on a TCC Automation prompt that a background context cannot display. Nothing resolves it, so it hangs until timeout.
payload.measured: 90 second timeout, no error returned, no message sent.
payload.fix: Run anything that pushes or sends as a launchd agent in a user session with Automation granted, and split sending into a queue step that never blocks and a drain step that only runs where permission exists.
payload.why_it_matters: The failure is not the hang. Silence looks identical to nothing happened, so a watchdog wired to text you goes quiet overnight while reporting itself healthy.
